landmarks.name: Hockenheim occupied grandstand foundations and forecourts
landmarks.source_note: Only the actual Nordtribuene footprint and the three authored main/Sued seating ribbons with their protected forecourts receive inferred ground beneath exposed terraces. Retained GLO30 DSM roof/terrace mounds buried actual seat meshes by 3.95–9.01m. Adjacent native road-plane anchors estimate substructure ground; this is not a bare-earth survey. Actual roads, shoulders, escape paving, unrelated buildings, the two clear stands and outer berms are excluded. The guessed Nord230–430 seating overlapped service footprints532896900/901; actual footprint-clipped Nord seating replaces it, leaving both service footprints unchanged. Retained mapped owners register the stand complexes; seating/setback dimensions remain reference reconstructions.

landmarks.name: Nordtribüne continuous mapped terraces
landmarks.source_note: Continuous supplied 136/137/138 s shows coherent Nord seating and a supported roof through the first right corner. Actual mapped curved footprint and road-facing boundary set the plan. Constant owned foundation and continuous distance-band rows replace bay-local DSM lifts. Roof level, terrace section and approximately 8 m rear support spacing are visual estimates, not an engineering survey. No shared stand producer or native track profile changed.
